name: Sequential Batch CASE State Machine
description: Three-step Fill/Mix/Drain batch sequence. Uses CASE statement with explicit ELSE safe-state. All output assignments inside CASE branches only.
safety_notes: ELSE branch is mandatory — handles any undefined Step_State value safely. Fill_Valve and Drain_Valve must never be TRUE at the same time. Batch_Complete cleared when new batch starts.
common_mistakes: Missing ELSE branch — undefined state leaves outputs in unknown condition
Not clearing Batch_Complete when new batch starts
Allowing Start_PB to restart batch while Fault_State is TRUE
